_doc: OPFOR — the hostile side's OWN pack, placeholder until P4 makes it the real DPRK-flavored faction. Extends the shared US library but fields only the listed subset (today's game reality: generic platforms both sides).
name: OPFOR
_callsigns_doc: The opposition is COUNTED, not named — E01, E02. That is the COP's own convention for a force whose designations we do not know, and it is why hostile tracks never read like friendly ones.
